description.intro: The Puma Liga Portugal 26 27 Cup T.5 Stellar ball is designed to offer excellent performance in training and amateur matches. Inspired by the official ball of the Portuguese League, it combines resistance, good touch and great durability to withstand sessions of frequent use. Its abrasion-resistant construction ensures reliable and consistent performance every play.
